RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, February 13, 2014/Magha 24, 1935 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Development of North Eastern
Region; Environment and Forests; External Affairs; Housing and Urban
Poverty Alleviation; Overseas Indian Affairs; Panchayati Raj;
Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances and
Pensions; Planning; Road Transport and Highways;
Shipping; Space; Steel; Tourism; Tribal Affairs;
Urban Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Tourism policy for Punjab
*321. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) whether Amritsar and other places
in Punjab have tremendous tourism
potential; and
(b) if so, the efforts that have been made
by the Ministry in consultation with the
State Government to exploit the tourism
potential of Amritsar and other places in
Punjab?
Projects cleared during the last two
months
*322. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of projects that have
been cleared by the Ministry during the
last two months, the details of these
projects; and
(b) whether these applications were
pending before the Ministry for a long time;
if so, the details thereof?
Air pollution in rural areas
†*323. SHRI BHAGAT SINGH
KOSHYARI: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether air pollution is on the rise
in rural areas due to expansion of industries,
if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether any study has been
conducted about the effects of air pollution
in rural areas, if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
by Government to spread awareness
among rural people about air pollution?
Roads/stretches to be declared as NHs
in Andhra Pradesh
*324. SHRI DEVENDER GOUD T.:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

112
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
of Andhra Pradesh has submitted proposals
to declare 48 roads/stretches for declaring
them as National Highways in the last three
years and the current year; and
(b) if so, the action taken by the
Ministry on the same?
Misbehaviour with Indian diplomat in
America
†*325. SHRI THAAW AR CHAND
GEHLOT: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL  AFFAIRS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has taken cognizance of the incident of
misbehaviour with an Indian woman
diplomat by the United States of America;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
details of the action taken by Government
in protest of this incident;
(c) whether it is also a fact that there
have been such incidents of misbehaviour
with Indian diplomats, politicians and other
eminent people in the United States of
America earlier also, if so, the details
thereof; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government in this regard?
Expansion and modernization
programme of SAIL
*326. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased to
state:
(a) the total projected investment to be
made by the Steel Authority of India Ltd.
(SAIL) in the current expansion and
modernization programme;
(b) the likely share for the special and
alloy steel plants; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether there is any long term plan
to increase SAIL's presence and market
share in special and alloy steel market?
Upgradation of facilities of PSKs in
Tamil Nadu
*327. DR. R. LAKSHMANAN: Will
the Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Tamil Nadu
is one of the top five States with high
number of Passport Applications;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to upgrade the facilities available at Passport
Seva Kendras (PSKs), which are the
extended arms of Regional Passport Office,
so that delivery mechanism pertaining to
issuance of passport is suitably augmented;
and
(c) if no such steps have been taken so
far by Government, whether it would come
forward to take such steps in the coming
days?
Protection of reserves and forests in
Assam
*328. SHRI SANTIUSE KUJUR: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that most reserves
and forests in Assam are under
encroachment where people began
cultivation by destroying the forest and as
a result, the habitat of various species is in
danger and on the verge of extinction, if so,
the details thereof; and
(b) the steps taken by the State and the
Central Government, to protect forests?

113

to defer premium payments
*329. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any
proposal allowing highway developers to
defer premium payments in stalled
projects, particularly in Andhra Pradesh
for the Eleventh and Twelfth Plan period;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise
and the present

————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Development of North Eastern
Region; Environment and Forests; External Affairs; Housing and Urban
Poverty Alleviation; Overseas Indian Affairs; Panchayati Raj;
Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances and
Pensions; Planning; Road Transport and Highways;
Shipping; Space; Steel; Tourism; Tribal Affairs;

Total number of questions — 155
Power plants in the country
2332. SHRI N. BALAGANGA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the installed capacity
and the actual power generation from
Nuclear Power Plants in the country;
(b) the steps taken by Government to
improve the power generation from these
nuclear power plants;
(c) whether Government has any
proposal to set up some more nuclear
power plants, if so, the details thereof, and
if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
increase power generation in the country?
Failure of AERB to develop safety
policy
2333. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN:
SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Atomic Energy
Regulatory Board (AERB) has failed to
develop safety policy, standards, codes and
guides; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and reasons
therefor?
Development projects for North-East
2334. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that infrastructural
projects and development projects meant
for North-Eastern projects are hindered by
the twin problems of Insurgency and
Environment clearances;
(b) if so, the details of the projects which
are stalled; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
remove the hurdles so that the projects are
completed with the original estimated
costs?

604
Steps for smooth functioning
of NEC
2335. SHRI K.C. TYAGI: Will the
Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the major initiatives
taken by the North-Eastern Council (NEC)
in the recent past for the overall
development of North-Eastern Region,
including maintaining of regional balances;
(b) the functional and hierarchical
relationship between the Ministry and the
NEC;
(c) whether overlapping in the functions
of the two bodies had affected
implementation of programmes, policies
and had also raised issues of accountability,
if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the effective steps taken by the
Union Government to ensure the smooth
functioning of the NEC?
Infrastructural development of NE
States
2336. SHRIMATI W ANSUK SYIEM:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the infrastructural
development needs of the North-Eastern
region was recently discussed between the
Prime Minister and the Chief Minister of
the NE States;
(b) a summary of issues discussed at
the meeting; and
(c) whether Meghalaya had taken up
the issue of strengthening of border trading
facilities with Bangladesh, if so, the details
thereof?
Satellite Management Report
2337. SHRI RAMA CHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken by the Ministry of
Environment and Forests for creating
awareness about the environment pollution
and forest protection;
(b) whether the forest coverage of our
country is increasing, if so, the State-wise
details for last three years; and
(c) whether the Satellite measurement
also include the sugarcane, wheat and
cornfield if so, how to eliminate these area
in the satellite measurement report?
Conservation of musk deers
†2338. SHRI MAHENDRA SINGH
MAHRA: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of States where musk
deers are found and at what altitudes;
(b) the steps taken by Central
Government so far for the conservation of
musk deers;
(c) whether Government is bringing an
ordinance for the conservation of musk deer;
and
(d) if so, at what altitude Government
will start the conservation of the musk
deers?
Air and water quality in six metros
2339. SHRI BAISHNAB PARIDA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that air and water
quality has worsened in all six metros in
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

the country as per report of TERI
Environmental survey;
(b) if so, the details thereof, inter-alia
indicating the status of Delhi; and
(c) whether Government has worked
out an action plan to address the above
issue, if so, the details thereof?
